blocking_union.root_cause: At 900×700 the expanded card's large image is shrunk until the whole card fits the timeline. The card also carries the 96px header thumbnail, the header prompt, a second copy of the full prompt, 高级参数 and the action row, so little height is left and the 大图 ends up at or near thumbnail size. I opened three captures. busy-other-media-narrow: the large image is 96px, the same size as the thumbnail directly above it. verify-selected-full-size-narrow: a 1024×1024 image shows at about 110px. real-attempt-selected-actions-narrow: about 149 CSS px, against the 96px thumbnail. Wide captures get about 182–247px. Nothing is clipped, and both action buttons are now fully visible, so round-1 U-01/U-02 are fixed. The way U-02 was fixed (capping the image by the space left in the timeline) caused this regression: at the narrow width the page's main output can no longer really be viewed.
blocking_union.severity_note: Reviewer 1 rated this major (10 narrow harness screenshots fail) and rated the same root cause minor in batch B. Reviewer 2 rated it a note on the grounds that the criteria give a maximum size (≤60vh) but no minimum. Kept at major, the highest severity raised, as the union rule requires. See disagreement 1.

blocking_union.repair_suggestion: Remove the duplication before growing the image. When a card is expanded, hide the header thumbnail (the large image replaces it) and shorten the header prompt to the one-line summary; the full prompt stays under the image. This frees about 130px at 900×700. Then give the large image a real floor, e.g. max-height: min(60vh, ) with min-height ≈ 240px, and when the floor wins, scroll the card so the actions stay reachable (keep the round-1 U-01 scroll-into-view behaviour) instead of shrinking the image further. Add an e2e assertion at 900×700 that the expanded is rendered at ≥ 2× the thumbnail height and that the action buttons are inside the timeline box. Re-capture every listed narrow state in both batches. The contract needs a matching change (routed as follow-up in the closure audit): add a minimum rendered size for 大图 to attempt-selected-actions / timeline-three-rounds in visual-acceptance-criteria.md/.json, so the next round has no reason to disagree.

non_blocking.root_cause: In the real app's delete dialog (WKWebView), 取消 shows no visible focus ring, so the must-show 「取消」获得焦点 cannot be confirmed from pixels. I opened both captures. The harness delete-confirm-wide (Chromium) shows a clear blue ring on 取消. The real-delete-confirm-wide does not, and the list item behind the dialog keeps its blue double outline. So either focus is not moved in WKWebView, or :focus-visible is not applied to programmatic focus there. journey.json does not record the focused element.
non_blocking.repair_suggestion: Style the dialog's default button with a ring that does not depend on :focus-visible heuristics (e.g. .dialog button:focus or a data-default class). Have real_journey.py record document.activeElement's text when the dialog is open (owner image-session-verify), and recapture.

summary: Round 2 fails the visual review with one blocking item. All 8 round-1 blocking items are closed: actions are reachable, the three-round pair exists, the cancelled explanation renders, a post-delete image page is captured, and the 种子 scope is settled by D-50a. The U-02 fix introduced a new major, B-01. At 900×700 the expanded card's 大图 is shrunk to 96–150px, at or barely above the 96px thumbnail, because the card also repeats the thumbnail and the prompt. Reviewer 1 rated it major and reviewer 2 a note (the criteria give no minimum). It stays major under the union rule, and I agree after opening the screenshots. Non-blocking: the focus ring is missing on 取消 in the real app's dialog (both reviewers, minor), titles are cut too short beside 生成中, and 新会话 has no bottom margin; there are also notes. No blank or broken images, no 种子 on the image page, no horizontal scroll and no clipped buttons anywhere.
